name: The Karnitol Shipwreck
summary: Kreldig Ungor tells you of Karnitol, a mage who is some kind of noble in Stormwind. Sea giants struck his ship in the northwest waters of Desolace, and he left a valuable chest behind and teleported away. The chest and what is inside are to be found.

sections.title: A Noble's Flight
sections.body: After Reclaimers' Business in Desolace, Kreldig Ungor tells you of a first order of business. It concerns Karnitol, a mage who is some kind of noble in Stormwind. Sea giants struck Karnitol's ship in the northwest waters of Desolace. Karnitol and his servants tried to carry one of his costlier chests to shore, but the giants swarmed in, and he gave up the chest and teleported himself and his servants out. The chest and its contents are to be found, then returned to Karnitol in Stormwind. It lies along the northern coastline, in the Ethel Rethor stretch.

sections.title: What the Chest Shows
sections.body: The chest shows no water damage, but the lid has been forced open, and burn marks around the edges show that any magical traps guarding it were sprung long ago.
